summaries.title: DeepAgent: A General Reasoning Agent with Scalable Toolsets
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**智能体与代码工程**（Agents & SWE）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「显存占用与端侧资源受限、长程上下文建模与远距历史记忆衰减」痛点，作者围绕 **DeepAgent** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、工具调用（Tool Use）。核心论点主张：In this paper, we introduce DeepAgent, an end-to-end deep reasoning agent that performs autonomous thinking, tool discovery, and action execution within a single, coherent...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用强化学习策略优化与奖励驱动对齐、感知-规划-工具执行闭环智能体架构、动态记忆槽更新与检索增强机制。评测基准/数据集涵盖 **GAIA**。实验设计与验证细节：Large reasoning models have demonstrated strong problem-solving abilities, yet real-world tasks often require external tools and long-horizon interactions。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Extensive experiments on eight benchmarks, including general tool-use tasks (ToolBench, API-Bank, TMDB, Spotify, ToolHop) and downstream applications (ALFWorld, WebShop, GAIA, HLE),...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为社区高关注度代表作（HF 101 赞），本工作为突破 **智能体脚手架、工具与技能 (Harness & Skills)、全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 中的「显存占用与端侧资源受限」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: Video-As-Prompt: Unified Semantic Control for Video Generation

summaries.title: A Definition of AGI
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**推理与测试时计算**（Reasoning & TTC）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「显存占用与端侧资源受限、系统性评测缺失与内在作用机理不明」痛点，作者围绕 **A Definition of AGI** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖持久记忆机制（Persistent Memory），并引入 Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：This paper introduces a quantifiable framework to address this, defining AGI as matching the cognitive versatility and proficiency of a well-educated adult。（入选月度技术树 `[COMBO]` 技能「定义 AGI / Defining AGI」）
